test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 07
subject: general
question:
In the following question, a set of letters is given. To what logic/rule/relation is the letters of each group related to the letters of the same group. From the given options, select a group of letters that follows the same logic/rule/relationship.

(MN, PK, SH)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The logic followed is:

**Given: (MN, PK, SH)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b72277dd07c42a6d71aa50b2f5c81ce829b0d7b70411f9fca6e9b15aea13a0c7.png] 

Option 1: For,"(RF, UC, WZ)"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a19bdb7b2adffffb9d5fce617447ab127d050c6793589acd3e40522f67a4b2f6.png] 

This is not following the common relation of -3, +3

Option 2: For,"(CD, FA, IW)"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b285ac1eb8c883254f8a8ca9eeef149f236e5236bc59ba49d852b1b0f2ee0b62.png] 

This is not following the common relation of -3, +3

Option 3: For, "(VU, YR, AO)"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e7ebd7fa4a6a2a53d878e1638141f3dddaf376a01b9a8dd2a9b478989cd8db7.png] 

This is not following the common relation of -3, +3

**Option 4: For,** **"(IC, LZ, OW)"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/683dcf9a18a59bb39ba9062a71bebc76ad08386e82511479e36f04395ccf4665.png] 

**Thus we can see this is following the common relation of -3, +3.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"(IC, LZ, OW)".**
